entries.zh: 道谢；致谢（首二字漫漶，释义存疑）
entries.en: to give thanks; to express gratitude (reading uncertain)
entries.notes: L 'cagracia' 疑为 'gracias' 之讹；H 首字（漏/满）与 M/R 'po po' 音不合，仅末字 謝 可定。

entries.zh: 使落入……（所指不明，释义存疑）
entries.en: to give so that (it) falls into ... (referent unclear)
entries.notes: 四栏不能互证：H'花膠流'/M'hŏg ca lāu' 与 L'caiga en laleya'（疑 la leña 或 iglesia）不合。

entries.zh: 传报；传话报信；带回回话
entries.en: to send word; to relay a message; to bring back a reply
entries.notes: M 栏末音 toūn 当为 轉(tńg)，与 L 'arueltà'（a vuelta，回话）相应。

entries.en: to give occasion for an uproar; to raise a clamour
entries.notes: L 'lugaraſ pasecotas' 后半未详，义依 H/R 嚷鬧 定。

entries.zh: 叙述情形；说明经过；陈情
entries.en: to give an account of how something happened; to relate the circumstances
entries.notes: L 'ecade hader' 漫漶（疑 acaeció），义依 H/M/R 敘情 定。

entries.en: to bestow from above; to grant (as a superior)
entries.notes: L 'ſuenga arriba' 词形不明，义据 賜來 定。

entries.en: to strike one another; to come to blows

entries.zh: 相踏；互相践踏；拥挤踩踏
entries.en: to tread on one another; to trample each other
to turn round; to revolve
entries.notes: M 栏于 'lîn chūy' 外另出 chōan 一读，未详。

entries.en: to turn over and over; to roll over

entries.zh: 轮子转动；回旋不停（引申作“轮回”）
entries.en: the wheel turns; to revolve (extended: the cycle of rebirth)
to turn over downward; to roll downwards
to turn backwards; to reverse the turning
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:到/倒]，M 'cō' 与 倒(tò) 合；L 'rebedor' 词形未详。

entries.en: to go round about; to circulate
of (genitive/possessive particle)
entries.notes: M 仅 Gē 一音、R 'pañ. cō' 未能对译；义据 L（属格）与 个 定。

entries.zh: 於；在；从（介词，表处所或来源）
entries.en: at; in; from (preposition)
according to; after the manner of
entries.notes: L 尾段 'an chio se della manera' 残缺，仅 'de la manera' 可辨。

entries.en: in a moment; for a short while
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:需/雲] 与 M 'fiâp' 不合，疑为 霎（雨部形近）；L 'amanecio' 亦与“霎久”不谐。

entries.en: two days from now; two days hence
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:陽/隔]，M 'que' 与 隔(keh) 音合，定为 隔。

entries.en: an instant; a moment
entries.notes: H 原作 [疑:雲/霧]，与第 18、21 条 M'fiâp'/R'jāng' 同源，疑为 霎。

entries.zh: 霎仔久；一会儿；片刻之间
entries.en: in a very short while; shortly
entries.notes: L 'amatriaco' 疑为 'a un ratico'（'vn' 误读作 'm'）；H 首字 [疑] 疑为 霎。
